summary: Probe folder membership payload variants without enabling unverified writes.
reason: Alternative handler names did not persist a folder. This probe tested whether save-list-folder needs folderItems, a root-folder membership update, or both operations atomically.

variants: new folder with folderItems containing the new folder
root folder payload with the new folder membership
new folder and root membership in one operation list
evidence.result: All three candidates returned HTTP 200 but none appeared in a fresh GetUserData response.
evidence.cleanup: No marker folder remained; cleanup was available for any candidate that read back successfully.

validated_outcome: The known protobuf payload variants are not sufficient evidence to enable folder writes. Folder gates remain disabled pending authenticated browser traffic or an exact working wire contract.
